purpose: Teach: 駆ら/向かわ/住環境/引き取っ/鉄筋コンクリート/取り外し/同乗/拝聴

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 熱意に駆られた若手社員を抜擢しましょう
lines.en: Let's promote the young staff who are really driven by enthusiasm.
lines.style: Bright but careful opening, the proposal rising gently, seeking agreement rather than commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外向かわせる出張者の研修を整えます
lines.en: Sure. I'll set up the training for the people we're sending overseas.
lines.style: Easy agreeing nod in the voice, relaxed mid-pace, dependable rather than eager.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 住環境調査の結果を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the results of the living-environment survey.
lines.style: Soft organizing tone, working down her list, a small polite lift at the proposal's end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。退社する社員の業務を引き取って整理します
lines.en: Right. I'll take over the leaving employee's workload and sort it out.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pickup, slightly quicker pace, the sound of someone already drafting the handover.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 鉄筋コンクリート新社屋の竣工を祝いましょう
lines.en: Let's celebrate the completion of the new reinforced concrete office building.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through the meeting cadence, brightening audibly on the celebration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い設備の取り外し時期を調整します
lines.en: Yep. I'll work out the timing for removing the old equipment.
lines.style: Calm logistical reply, even rhythm, the faint dry humor of a man juggling calendars.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社用車の同乗時の安全規定を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's double-check the safety rules for riding together in the company cars.
lines.style: Careful, conscientious phrasing, slowing on the safety point, gently insistent without pressing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界専門家のお話を拝聴する機会を作ります
lines.en: Sure. I'll set up a chance for us to hear from an industry expert.
lines.style: Wrap-up warmth, unhurried close, a small satisfied settling on the final commitment.
